title: AEON Block Manifest
description: Every block in src/blocks/ must have a block.manifest.json following this spec

id.description: Snake_case unique block ID matching the folder name

label.description: Display name shown in nav and block store

icon.description: Single emoji or Lucide icon name

description.description: One-line summary of what this block does

deployment.description: universal=works on Vercel+local, local_required=needs OS/hardware, hybrid=core works on cloud

tier.description: core=always present, free=ships with base, plugin=installable addon

apis.description: API keys needed: groq, gemini, openai, claude, firebase, supabase, coinbase, canva, gas, youtube

local.description: Local services needed: ollama, ffmpeg, lmstudio, python

blocks.description: Other block IDs this block reads from (legitimate dependencies only)

api_routes.description: true if this block has an api/ subfolder with backend routes
